headline: Approved Brian LaGrasse as Senior Health Inspector effective September 7, 2026, and approved the May 20, 2026 minutes.
summary: The meeting covered the Director's report, including senior center and teen center activities, tuberculosis case counts, Ebola monitoring, health inspections, and addiction and gambling services. The board voted to approve the May 20, 2026 minutes and to appoint Brian LaGrasse as Senior Health Inspector.
decisions: Approved Brian LaGrasse as Senior Inspector effective September 7, 2026, 3-0.

## Directors Report

### Introduction of new Senior Health Inspector Brian LaGrasse

After a brief discussion of Brian LaGrasse work experience and a review of his resume a Motion to approve Brian LaGrassse as Senior Inspector effective September 7, 2026, was made by Mr. John Colangeli, seconded by Dr. Kunwar Singh. Motion passes 3-0.

## Senior Center

### May

- On May 1st, 2026, we hosted a birthday celebration for seniors born in May, providing an opportunity for participants to celebrate with friends and fellow community members at the center.
- On May 8th, 2026, Mystic Valley Elder Services celebrated its 50th anniversary with seniors. Attendees learned about the programs, resources, and support services MVES provides to the Malden community.
- On May 11th, 2026, we hosted a Nutrition and Bone Health class led by a certified dietitian from Mystic Valley Elder Services. Seniors received education on healthy eating habits and nutritional practices that support and preserve bone health as they age.
- On May 12th, 2026, we honored Mother's Day with a spring-themed celebration featuring refreshments and sweets for participants to enjoy together.

### June

- Elder Abuse Awareness Day (June 15): Hosted a small fair-style event featuring 10\u201315 local vendors providing resources and services for older adults, including Mystic Valley Elder Services and several City departments, such as the Fire Department, Police Department, and Housing Stability Office.
- Father's Day Celebration (June 22): Organized a Father's Day celebration for senior center participants.
- Seniors' Prom (June 26): Hosted the annual Seniors' Prom, providing an opportunity for social engagement and community celebration.
- Debbie's Retirement Party (June 30): Celebrated Debbie's retirement in recognition of her 37 years of dedicated service and contributions.

### July

- On Wednesday July 8th at 12PM (Noon), The First Baptist Church passed summer gift baskets to seniors here in our Atrium.
- Malden Senior Center hosted a free Hearing Test on Monday, July 6th from 11:00 to 3:00 PM.
- New class: Chinese Calligraphy, Thursday 10:00am to 11:30am (ONGOING)
- Summer BBQ, On Friday, July 17th from 11am to 12pm, sponsored by MVES.

### August

# Brian J. LaGrasse
(978) 265-4259
blagrasse@gmail.com

## SUMMARY

Public Health and Environmental Compliance Executive with 20+ years of experience leading regulatory enforcement, inspection programs, construction oversight and multi-jurisdictional public health initiatives. Demonstrated expertise in interpreting and applying complex regulations, conducting audits and investigations, and managing high-impact emergency response operations. Proven ability to secure and administer large-scale grants, develop policy, and collaborate across government and private stakeholders to ensure compliance and mitigate risk.

## CORE COMPETENCIES

Environmental & Public Health Compliance • Regulatory Enforcement & Interpretation • Inspections & Audits • Risk Assessment & Mitigation • Emergency Preparedness & Incident Command (ICS/NIMS) • Grant Writing & Administration • Policy & Regulation Development • Cross-Functional Leadership • Stakeholder Engagement • Program Development & Construction Oversight

## PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

**Director of Public Health**
**Town of North Andover, MA | 2016 – 2026**

Provide executive leadership for all public health and environmental compliance operations for a municipal department serving both local and regional populations.

- Direct and oversee comprehensive compliance programs including food safety, housing, septic systems, building construction, public pools, hazardous materials, and environmental nuisance conditions
- Work with restaurant operators on permitting, kitchen design, equipment specifications, HACCP review and compliance with state, local and federal regulations
- Manage a $532K annual shared services grant, leading a six-community regional public health collaborative to expand service delivery and compliance capacity
- Supervise multidisciplinary staff including inspectors, nurses, administrative personnel, and regional team members; oversee external consultants and technical specialists
- Conduct inspections, audits, and investigations; issue enforcement actions including violation notices, orders to correct, and court filings as necessary
- Interpret and enforce Massachusetts General Laws, state sanitary codes, and local bylaws, ensuring consistent regulatory compliance
- Lead all emergency preparedness and response efforts, including pandemic planning and full operational leadership during COVID-19 and a major regional gas emergency
- Prepared all Public Health public service announcements and press releases for emergencies and for general messaging.
- Coordinate foodborne illness investigations in partnership with state agencies, ensuring timely response and regulatory compliance
- Perform technical reviews of septic designs, restaurant plans, and building permit applications for compliance with health regulations
- Develop and implement local regulations, including solid waste hauling and environmental control measures; monitor compliance of waste transfer and disposal operations
- Represent the municipality in regional coalitions focused on bioterrorism, infectious disease response, and environmental health planning
- Prepare and manage departmental budgets, annual reports, strategic planning initiatives and manage several revolving accounts with large scale contracts for multiple subcontractors
- Represented Public Health Region 3 on the Massachusetts Health and Medical Coordinating Coalition (HMCC) Board of Directors from 2018-2026

**Director of Public Health**
**City of Methuen, MA | 2006 – 2016**

Led all environmental health, regulatory enforcement, and public health operations.

- Managed compliance and enforcement programs across food safety, housing, environmental hazards, and public health regulations
- Supervised a team of inspectors, a code enforcement officer, public health nurse, and administrative staff, along with consultants and interns
- Secured and administered a $350K regional grant, establishing a tri-city public health district to improve service delivery and regulatory coordination
- Conducted inspections and compliance audits; issued violation notices and managed enforcement actions, including legal proceedings
- Collaborated with the Attorney General's Office on receivership and housing enforcement initiatives; secured additional funding to support these efforts
- Directed the Building Safety Task Force addressing abandoned and high-risk properties
- Integrated public health into the city's Comprehensive Emergency Management Plan (CEMP), serving as a key member of the emergency planning committee
- Chaired a regional public health coalition focused on infectious disease preparedness, mass vaccination, and emergency response planning
- Developed local regulations and adjusted fee structures to support program sustainability and compliance enforcement

**Health Agent**
**City of Amesbury, MA | 2004 – 2006**

Oversaw all public health and environmental compliance functions for the municipality.

- Conducted and supervised inspections across a wide range of compliance areas including food establishments, housing, septic systems, and environmental concerns
- Enforced state and local regulations through formal notices, orders, and legal proceedings
- Developed and implemented local health regulations to strengthen compliance frameworks
- Coordinated multi-agency emergency preparedness planning, including bioterrorism response and continuity of operations planning
- Led foodborne illness investigations in coordination with state public health authorities
- Served as Radiological Officer supporting emergency response operations related to a regional nuclear facility

**Public Health Inspector/Conservation Administrator**
**Town of North Andover, MA | 1999 – 2004**

- Performed environmental health inspections and regulatory enforcement across multiple program areas
- Drafted violation notices, enforcement orders, and recommendations for public hearings
- Coordinated foodborne illness investigations with state agencies
- Managed conservation and environmental compliance programs, including wetlands protection and land use regulation
- Reviewed permit applications, conducted site assessments, and issued regulatory decisions
- Enforced Local Bylaws and the Massachusetts Wetlands Protection Act
- Monitored construction and development projects for environmental compliance

**Associate Environmental Scientist**
**Groundwater & Environmental Services, Inc. | 1998 – 1999**

- Conducted Phase I and Phase II environmental site assessments and risk characterizations
- Performed soil and groundwater sampling and analyzed environmental data
- Supported remediation efforts including soil vapor extraction and air sparging systems
- Coordinated with regulatory agencies and private-sector stakeholders on compliance matters
